summary: Interpreted the repeat of the witness probe, which strengthened rather than merely confirmed it: the successor overlap appeared again in all six trials — another server leading at term 3 from 345-511ms while the old leader stayed at term 2 — and five of six trials returned VerifyLeader success at 931-932ms, against three of six in the first run, with only the 250ms reconnection answering leadership loss. Across both executions the overlap holds in twelve of twelve trials and success in eight of twelve, so the account now records the overlap as what reproduces while the verdict stays a per-trial choice between the ready verify case and the ready lease case; the single-execution limitation and the 'only three of six' counterevidence were replaced with those joint figures, the repeat receipt was added to the executions map, and the Fact was extended under its own id with both receipts. The defect claim, the resolved gap answer and the rest of the account are unchanged, and no execution is requested. Unfinished: nothing outstanding on the four questions, all of which carry accounts with receipts; if run time remains I would look for an independent lead rather than repeat what is already reproduced.
